people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.
translations.bsb: There the Philistines abandoned their gods, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
translations.kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
